monospace.name: Technical Telemetry Monospace
monospace.stack: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', 'Source Code Pro', 'Fira Code', Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
monospace.usage: Code manifests, numbers, status pills, coordinates, tickers, and technical badges

sans.name: Editorial Sans
sans.stack: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji'
sans.usage: Project titles, explanatory paragraphs, table text, and descriptive prose

micro.usage: Hardware telemetry labels, GPS coordinates, category headers

caption.usage: Table secondary metadata, license tags, timestamp badges

body-sm.usage: Code block lines, terminal manifest rows, item descriptions

body.usage: Primary project descriptions, markdown prose, blockquotes

display.usage: Hero title, Harmit Kalal identity anchor

rules.tabularNumbers: All metrics and numeric telemetry must render with monospace font or font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to prevent optical layout shift during state changes.
rules.minimumLegibleMobileSize: 10px absolute minimum inside SVGs at standard 1000px coordinate space to guarantee readability when scaled to 360px mobile viewports.
rules.letterSpacingDiscipline: Uppercase micro text must always maintain 1.0px to 2.0px letter-spacing for scannability; display text must use tight letter-spacing (-0.5px to -1.0px) for architectural cohesion.
